:::{#lem-complement-from-odds}
#### One over one plus the odds is the complement probability

Let $A$ be an [event](#def-event) with [probability](#def-probability) $\P(A) \in (0, 1)$
and [odds](#def-odds) $\odds$.
One over one plus the odds of $A$ is the probability that $A$ does not happen:

$$\frac{1}{1 + \odds} = 1 - \P(A).$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\frac{1}{1 + \odds}
&= \frac{1}{1 + \frac{\P(A)}{1 - \P(A)}}
&& \text{(definition of the odds)}
\\&= \frac{1}{\frac{1 - \P(A)}{1 - \P(A)} + \frac{\P(A)}{1 - \P(A)}}
&& \text{(} 1 = \tfrac{1 - \P(A)}{1 - \P(A)} \text{)}
\\&= \frac{1}{\frac{1 - \P(A) + \P(A)}{1 - \P(A)}}
&& \text{(add fractions with a common denominator)}
\\&= \frac{1}{\frac{1}{1 - \P(A)}}
&& \text{(} {-\P(A)} + \P(A) = 0 \text{)}
\\&= 1 - \P(A)
&& \text{(the reciprocal of a reciprocal)}
\ea
$$

:::
